author: GoPro
description:
The FWT heads to Alaska for the first Final of the 2026 season at the YETI Alaska Haines Pro. Making its long-awaited return to the Tour for the first time since 2017, Haines is widely regarded as one of the most iconic venues in big-mountain freeride. The landscape is filled with towering spines, massive faces, and legendary powder conditions shaped by the Pacific. Now, the stage is set for one of the most anticipated showdowns of the year as the riders who made the Cut battle for crucial points in the race for the 2026 FWT Champion title.

With only the top qualifiers remaining after a shortened regular season, the world’s best freeriders arrive in Alaska hungry to prove themselves on one of the sport’s ultimate proving grounds. Expect long, expressive runs down dramatic faces as athletes push the limits in pursuit of a place in freeride history.

Get behind the scenes access to the athletes of Freeride World Tour with @goprosnow's new series “Off the Record.”
